assessments.reasoning: The introduction names Erlang as the programming language and assigns the manual to that subject. Its Purpose section explicitly separates implementation sources and identifies the material as explanatory text and examples.

challenge.method: Compare the manual Purpose and its implementation pointers with the same release README, implementation controls and exact annotated release pin. Check whether language identity collapses into the runtime or a separately allocated language edition.
challenge.results: The README uses the name for the programming language and runtime, while the manual deliberately narrows its subject to the language. The tag and immutable commit identify the documentation snapshot. No independently numbered language edition, runtime or package identity follows.

limitations: The reviewed identity attaches to the named language in the exact OTP 27.3.4 documentation. Runtime and distribution references are related context.
